SELECT 
    j.id,
    j.role_title,
    j.discipline,
    j.location_city,
    j.location_state,
    j.salary_min_aud,
    j.salary_max_aud,
    j.pain_hypothesis,
    j.outreach_angle,
    j.employee_instruction,
    j.recommended_service,
    j.score_band::text,
    j.entity_type::text,
    c.name AS company_name,
    j.inferred_client_name
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id
WHERE j.id = '{{ $json.body.job_id }}'::uuid;

SELECT
    c.id,
    c.full_name,
    c.discipline::text,
    c.discipline_other,
    c.location_text,
    c.years_experience,
    c.salary_expectation,
    c.work_auth::text,
    c.headline,
    c.summary_self,
    c.strengths,
    c.concerns_or_gaps,
    c.best_fit_role_types,
    c.availability_signal,
    c.follow_up_questions,
    c.niche_match_score,
    c.status::text,
    c.cv_filename
FROM candidates c
WHERE c.archived = false
AND c.status::text NOT IN ('declined', 'blacklisted', 'inactive', 'placed')
ORDER BY c.niche_match_score DESC NULLS LAST;

INSERT INTO candidate_job_matches (
    candidate_id,
    job_id,
    matched_by,
    ai_compatibility_score,
    ai_match_reasoning,
    ai_match_concerns,
    ai_matched_at,
    status
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.candidate_id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $json.job_id }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $json.triggered_by }}'::citext,
    {{ $json.score }},
    {{ $json.reasoning ? "'" + $json.reasoning.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.concerns ? "'" + $json.concerns.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    now(),
    'pending_screen'
)
ON CONFLICT (candidate_id, job_id) DO UPDATE SET
    ai_compatibility_score = EXCLUDED.ai_compatibility_score,
    ai_match_reasoning = EXCLUDED.ai_match_reasoning,
    ai_match_concerns = EXCLUDED.ai_match_concerns,
    ai_matched_at = EXCLUDED.ai_matched_at,
    updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, candidate_id, ai_compatibility_score;
